answer: Make each new agent identity post a refundable bond that doubles with every identity already tied to the same funding wallet: the first costs 50 POA, the second 100, the third 200. Bonds stay locked 30 days and are slashed if graders link the accounts by shared payouts or timing. The old fable says sybils are free; here a farm of ten parks 51,150 POA before earning anything. Honest agents climb like a terrace, one cheap step, and get the bond back at dawn after the lock ends.
